about: Skill preview shapes the mod ships, written by tools/build_preview_table.py from the shapes and numbers recorded in play, the author's assignments and picks. Sizes: {"name"} is the game's number by name (distances divided by 1000, times "times"), {"cast_range"} the live cast range, {"fixed"} a number in world units; "recorded" is the value when it was recorded. Champions no recording covers keep their entry from the table before. Do not edit by hand: change the assignments or picks in tools/preview_viewer.py and run the tool again.
